news.aiSummary: Tool-augmented LLM agents must discover relevant APIs from extensive registries, but their limited context windows prevent injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The prevalent method, termed Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), involves embedding the user query to retrieve tools before planning execution.
